thread:
jenny_customer: Hey team — urgent: during a routine test of the pricing preview flow a live charge was created for a customer. Not sure how a preview call became a charge. Help please.

alex_support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the request you used and the response you saw? Threading an incident ticket for tracking.

jenny_customer: pasted below. note we called the client endpoint /v1/pricing/preview which should only estimate; body is small. Response ID shows tool invoked: charge_customer.
```json
{
  "customer_id": "cus_1234",
  "items": [{"sku": "pro_monthly", "qty": 1}],
  "currency": "USD",
  "amount": 1999,
  "preview_only": true
}
```

Response:
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "invoked_tool": "charge_customer",
  "charge_id": "ch_live_987"
}
```

maria_engineer: :eyes: thanks jenny. quick hypothesis: autorouter uses signature heuristics and saw an explicit amount field so it picked the charging tool (charge_customer) which accepts amount. The preview endpoint should explicitly resolve to estimate_charge/preview tool only.

tim_pm: This is scary — that means test traffic can bill customers. Any idea how this slipped through? We added preview_only earlier but maybe schema wasn't enforced server-side.

alex_support: I pulled routing logs — autorouter decision: confidence 0.62 for charge_customer vs 0.58 for estimate_charge. The tie-breaker currently favors older tool (charge_customer).

maria_engineer: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) POST same payload to /v1/pricing/preview 2) because amount present, autorouter matched charge signature first 3) the preview_only flag is optional in the schema so it didn't disqualify charge_customer 4) created a live charge when authorization flow was enabled.

maria_engineer: Short-term mitigation: disable legacy tie-breaker favoring charge_customer on the preview path and add a server-side enforcement that preview_only=true => route to estimate_charge OR return 4xx if unsupported. Also add a hard rule: preview endpoints cannot call side-effecting tools.

alex_support: I've disabled charge_customer routing for /v1/pricing/* in the staging routing map and pushed a hotfix to reject requests to production preview endpoints that include preview_only but would route to charge_customer. Ops ticket created: INC-2026-48.

ops-bot: alert: INC-2026-48 created by alex_support. Affected customers: 1 confirmed (cus_1234). Suggested action: refund ch_live_987 and run audit for other preview calls in last 24h.

tim_pm: Can we add a unit test to the autorouter to prefer tools with explicit "safe: true" metadata for preview endpoints? Also add a contract test so preview_only must be required for preview API.

maria_engineer: Agreed. I'll add: 1) router heuristic change (prefer safe tools when endpoint tagged preview) 2) require preview_only boolean in swagger for /v1/pricing/preview 3) postmortem + alerts for any side-effecting tool being invoked from read-only endpoints.

jenny_customer: Thanks everyone. Please keep me updated once refund is issued and root cause is deployed.

alex_support: Will update here. Refund initiated, audit running, patch PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/412 — set to ship after quick review. :white_check_mark:
